description: React component for browsing content, including filters, content display, and media player modal.

methods.name: Browse
methods.description: Main React functional component for browsing content with filters and media playback.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Updates URL search parameters to apply filters.

methods.name: onPlay
methods.description: Sets the selected item for playback.

methods.name: onProgress
methods.description: Saves playback progress to history via API.

methods.name: toggleWatchlist
methods.description: Adds or removes an item from the watchlist via API.

methods.name: isInWatchlist
methods.description: Checks if an item is in the watchlist.
